# Brian Foster — Provider Network Contract Manager, Meridian Health Plan

- **Relationship:** external — Diane's counterpart at **Meridian Health Plan**, Riverbend's
  largest commercial payer. The relationship runs through Diane and CFO
  [David Reinhart](david-reinhart.md).
- **What's active:** the **Meridian Health Plan contract renewal** — reimbursement rates and
  value-based terms; the current agreement lapses and renewal is **overdue** (see
  [commitments](../commitments.md)).
- **Cadence:** by phone/email during negotiation windows only; not internal.

## Notes
- Meridian is pushing tighter readmission-based penalties — ties to Riverbend's 15.2%
  readmission rate; David Reinhart leads the counter.
- **Meridian Health Plan** (the payer) is unrelated to any internal program — keep the two
  meanings of "Meridian" distinct.
